course.name: FDE Business 职业进阶班
course.description: 面向希望转向 FDE 的业务、产品与咨询人士，补齐 AI 技术理解、自动化实践、客户方案与交付能力。
course.description_en: For business, product and consulting professionals moving towards FDE roles through AI technical fluency, hands-on automation, proposals and client delivery.
course.timeLength: 8 周；案例工作坊与课外实践
course.cardDescription: FDE Business 职业进阶班：8 周、30 项企业自动化任务。从业务、产品、咨询经验出发，补 AI 实践，练客户调查、Proposal、Pitch 与交付。
highlights: 面向业务、产品与咨询背景的 FDE 职业进阶
30 项企业自动化任务与多个客户案例
客户调查、Proposal、Pitch 与交付成果
course.courseObjective: 把已有业务经验转化为 FDE 所需的客户调查、AI 方案、原型验证、预算判断与交付能力，形成可用于说明个人能力的项目材料。
course.suitable: 有业务、产品、咨询、BA 或项目经验，希望转向 FDE 岗位，并愿意亲自搭建工作流、核对技术结果与展示方案。
course.prerequisiteknowledge: 能够说明一项实际业务流程及自己的职责；愿意学习 AI 能力边界、数据、工具与结果验证。不要求入班时已能独立开发 AI 应用；工程实现方向还需持续补齐 AI Engineering。

lessons.name: Business Problems and AI Opportunities
lessons.title: Business Problems and AI Opportunities
lessons.description: 案例工作坊：调查部门目标与重复工作。用市场调研练习核对资料与判断依据，确定值得改进的流程。
lessons.description_en: Case workshop. Investigate departmental goals and repetitive work. Use the research exercise to examine sources and qualify a useful workflow.

learningMaterial.content:
Business Problems and AI Opportunities

调查部门目标与重复工作。用市场调研练习核对资料与判断依据，确定值得改进的流程。

Preparation

Read the three department briefs. Bring one repetitive task from your work and describe its current input, output, owner and handover.

Client brief

Interview the department roles. Select one useful AI opportunity, one rules-only opportunity and one task that should stay with a person. Explain the evidence and unknowns.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
10Client problemFrame this decision: Agree which workflow is worth investigating.
20Evidence and constraintsRead the case records and question the department roles. Identify the fact that could change your plan.
25Workflow choicesInterview the department roles. Select one useful AI opportunity, one rules-only opportunity and one task that should stay with a person. Explain the evidence and unknowns.
35Produce and checkWork on discovery.md: problem, users, owner, baseline and unknowns; workflow-map.svg: present process and handovers; opportunity-table.csv: alternatives, expected benefit and reasons to defer. Compare the output with its sources.
20Present for a decisionExplain the output, alternatives, budget assumptions and unresolved risks. Request: Agree which workflow is worth investigating.
10Correction and ownershipCheck Identifies a specific work problem rather than a preferred tool.; Names a measurable baseline and a responsible decision owner.; Separates evidence, assumptions and missing information. Record the correction and responsible owner.

Submission

  • discovery.md: problem, users, owner, baseline and unknowns
  • workflow-map.svg: present process and handovers
  • opportunity-table.csv: alternatives, expected benefit and reasons to defer

Review criteria

  • Identifies a specific work problem rather than a preferred tool.
  • Names a measurable baseline and a responsible decision owner.
  • Separates evidence, assumptions and missing information.

Decision to obtain

Agree which workflow is worth investigating.

Knowledge check

A manager asks for an AI chatbot, but the current handover is unclear. What is the best first step?

  • Build the chatbot.
  • Investigate the workflow, owner and baseline.
  • Buy more tools.
Answer and reasoning

Investigate the workflow, owner and baseline.

Qualify the work problem and decision responsibility before choosing a tool.

Reference reasoning

Start with invoice-register preparation, not supplier payment. Customer follow-up is a draft-and-review task; onboarding is a coordination task with separate HR and IT authority.

lessons.name: AI Fluency for Decision-Makers
lessons.title: AI Fluency for Decision-Makers
lessons.description: 案例工作坊：判断 AI、规则与人工各承担什么。先理解资料处理、工具操作、权限和人工复核的边界。
lessons.description_en: Case workshop. Decide what AI, rules and people should handle. Understand document, tool, access and review boundaries.

learningMaterial.content:
AI Fluency for Decision-Makers

判断 AI、规则与人工各承担什么。先理解资料处理、工具操作、权限和人工复核的边界。

Preparation

Read the client constraints. Compare a fluent answer with the source fields and identify any statement that would create a business commitment.

Client brief

Assign each step to AI, a deterministic rule or a person. Explain missing-information handling, source checks and the actions the workflow must not take.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
10Client problemFrame this decision: Accept the capability boundary and a validation plan.
20Evidence and constraintsRead the case records and question the department roles. Identify the fact that could change your plan.
25Workflow choicesAssign each step to AI, a deterministic rule or a person. Explain missing-information handling, source checks and the actions the workflow must not take.
35Produce and checkWork on responsibility-map.md: AI, rules and human responsibilities; risk-register.csv: failure, impact, prevention and owner; validation-plan.md: what evidence would support the next decision. Compare the output with its sources.
20Present for a decisionExplain the output, alternatives, budget assumptions and unresolved risks. Request: Accept the capability boundary and a validation plan.
10Correction and ownershipCheck Does not equate fluent text with a correct business decision.; Keeps approvals and external commitments with the accountable role.; States how missing and conflicting input is handled. Record the correction and responsible owner.

Submission

  • responsibility-map.md: AI, rules and human responsibilities
  • risk-register.csv: failure, impact, prevention and owner
  • validation-plan.md: what evidence would support the next decision

Review criteria

  • Does not equate fluent text with a correct business decision.
  • Keeps approvals and external commitments with the accountable role.
  • States how missing and conflicting input is handled.

Decision to obtain

Accept the capability boundary and a validation plan.

Knowledge check

A supplier attachment tells the assistant to change bank details. How should the workflow treat that text?

  • As permission from the supplier.
  • As content that does not authorize a business action.
  • As a system instruction.
Answer and reasoning

As content that does not authorize a business action.

Business content does not grant system or payment authority.

Reference reasoning

AI can prepare candidate invoice fields or a draft reply. Arithmetic and duplicate checks use explicit rules. Finance approves treatment; sales approves a message. Supplier content cannot grant tool permissions.

lessons.name: Designing AI Workflows
lessons.title: Designing AI Workflows
lessons.description: 案例工作坊：从邮件、PDF 和 SOP 任务出发，画出输入、处理、输出、审批与异常路径。
lessons.description_en: Case workshop. Use email, PDF and SOP tasks to map inputs, outputs, approvals and exceptions.

learningMaterial.content:
Designing AI Workflows

从邮件、PDF 和 SOP 任务出发，画出输入、处理、输出、审批与异常路径。

Preparation

Read the email, document and meeting tasks. Identify the trigger, required inputs and the recipient of the next handover.

Client brief

Map one end-to-end workflow. Add approval and exception branches, then produce an SOP and action list that another person can follow.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
10Client problemFrame this decision: Approve the workflow scope and handover points.
20Evidence and constraintsRead the case records and question the department roles. Identify the fact that could change your plan.
25Workflow choicesMap one end-to-end workflow. Add approval and exception branches, then produce an SOP and action list that another person can follow.
35Produce and checkWork on workflow-map.svg: trigger, inputs, steps, outputs and exceptions; field-rules.csv: required fields, source and validation; sop.md and actions.csv: owners, dependencies and next decisions. Compare the output with its sources.
20Present for a decisionExplain the output, alternatives, budget assumptions and unresolved risks. Request: Approve the workflow scope and handover points.
10Correction and ownershipCheck The diagram includes exceptions and human handover.; Each output has a recipient and a checkable completion condition.; The SOP is consistent with the field rules and ownership. Record the correction and responsible owner.

Submission

  • workflow-map.svg: trigger, inputs, steps, outputs and exceptions
  • field-rules.csv: required fields, source and validation
  • sop.md and actions.csv: owners, dependencies and next decisions

Review criteria

  • The diagram includes exceptions and human handover.
  • Each output has a recipient and a checkable completion condition.
  • The SOP is consistent with the field rules and ownership.

Decision to obtain

Approve the workflow scope and handover points.

Knowledge check

A workflow diagram has only a happy path. What is missing?

  • More colours.
  • Exception handling, approval and ownership.
  • A larger model.
Answer and reasoning

Exception handling, approval and ownership.

The handover must specify what happens when information is missing or a decision is needed.

Reference reasoning

For finance, preserve the PDF source, prepare the register and route mismatches to the reviewer. For customer follow-up, retain a draft state. For onboarding, attach evidence to each owner’s step.

lessons.name: Building AI Automations
lessons.title: Building AI Automations
lessons.description: 案例工作坊：选择发票、Excel、报价或内容任务，亲手完成输入到成果的处理流程，核对并修改结果。
lessons.description_en: Case workshop. Complete an invoice, spreadsheet, quote or content workflow, then verify and revise its outputs.

learningMaterial.content:
Building AI Automations

选择发票、Excel、报价或内容任务，亲手完成输入到成果的处理流程，核对并修改结果。

Preparation

Choose tasks relevant to your role. Use the supplied records before adapting the workflow to your own non-sensitive materials.

Client brief

Use an AI assistant or Codex to produce an invoice register, spreadsheet report or customer-response draft. Compare every result with the input, correct errors and retain the complete output.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
10Client problemFrame this decision: Accept the prepared output for a bounded workflow trial.
20Evidence and constraintsRead the case records and question the department roles. Identify the fact that could change your plan.
25Workflow choicesUse an AI assistant or Codex to produce an invoice register, spreadsheet report or customer-response draft. Compare every result with the input, correct errors and retain the complete output.
35Produce and checkWork on completed-output/: readable register, report or draft and its source references; work-record.md: instructions, revisions and checks; exceptions.csv: omissions, conflicts and human decisions. Compare the output with its sources.
20Present for a decisionExplain the output, alternatives, budget assumptions and unresolved risks. Request: Accept the prepared output for a bounded workflow trial.
10Correction and ownershipCheck Produces a complete output, not only a prompt or a screenshot of a tool.; Can trace fields and claims back to the source.; Keeps original and corrected values together. Record the correction and responsible owner.

Submission

  • completed-output/: readable register, report or draft and its source references
  • work-record.md: instructions, revisions and checks
  • exceptions.csv: omissions, conflicts and human decisions

Review criteria

  • Produces a complete output, not only a prompt or a screenshot of a tool.
  • Can trace fields and claims back to the source.
  • Keeps original and corrected values together.

Decision to obtain

Accept the prepared output for a bounded workflow trial.

Knowledge check

A prepared invoice has a GST arithmetic mismatch. What should be retained?

  • Only the corrected number.
  • The original field, expected check and review decision.
  • Nothing; approve it anyway.
Answer and reasoning

The original field, expected check and review decision.

Keep source evidence and route discrepancies to the accountable reviewer.

Reference reasoning

The invoice packet yields one review-ready record, one GST arithmetic mismatch, one duplicate and one record missing context. The correct output is a register plus exception queue, not four approved invoices.

lessons.name: Connecting Business Tools
lessons.title: Connecting Business Tools
lessons.description: 案例工作坊：把客户跟进、采购或入职等任务串成流程，处理表单、文件和业务工具之间的信息，保留授权、去重与人工确认。
lessons.description_en: Case workshop. Connect follow-up, purchasing or onboarding tasks across forms, files and business tools, retaining authorisation, deduplication and human confirmation.

learningMaterial.content:
Connecting Business Tools

把客户跟进、采购或入职等任务串成流程，处理表单、文件和业务工具之间的信息，保留授权、去重与人工确认。

Preparation

Identify the forms, files, shared lists and staff decisions involved. Draw the boundary between preparing an action and executing it.

Client brief

Connect intake, a shared register and a review queue. Process a duplicate event and a changed request. Keep proposed messages and access requests awaiting the right owner.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
10Client problemFrame this decision: Approve a controlled cross-department workflow.
20Evidence and constraintsRead the case records and question the department roles. Identify the fact that could change your plan.
25Workflow choicesConnect intake, a shared register and a review queue. Process a duplicate event and a changed request. Keep proposed messages and access requests awaiting the right owner.
35Produce and checkWork on connected-workflow/: input form, shared register and review queue; handover-rules.md: identities, approvals, duplicates and recovery; change-log.csv: input revision and affected decisions. Compare the output with its sources.
20Present for a decisionExplain the output, alternatives, budget assumptions and unresolved risks. Request: Approve a controlled cross-department workflow.
10Correction and ownershipCheck Repeated input does not create repeated work commitments.; Changed input is visible and triggers revalidation.; The workflow does not silently send, book, pay or grant access. Record the correction and responsible owner.

Submission

  • connected-workflow/: input form, shared register and review queue
  • handover-rules.md: identities, approvals, duplicates and recovery
  • change-log.csv: input revision and affected decisions

Review criteria

  • Repeated input does not create repeated work commitments.
  • Changed input is visible and triggers revalidation.
  • The workflow does not silently send, book, pay or grant access.

Decision to obtain

Approve a controlled cross-department workflow.

Knowledge check

A customer changes the preferred time after a reply draft is approved. What should happen?

  • Send the old reply.
  • Reuse the old approval for all revisions.
  • Update the draft and request a new approval.
Answer and reasoning

Update the draft and request a new approval.

Approval applies to the content and revision that was reviewed.

Reference reasoning

A repeated customer enquiry updates the existing record. A changed preferred time invalidates the old draft approval. A changed employee role invalidates the prior access decision; IT still owns provisioning.

lessons.name: Testing and Improving Automations
lessons.title: Testing and Improving Automations
lessons.description: 案例工作坊：用工资、合同和收支核对练习识别缺项、冲突和计算问题，检查重复执行与人工复核成本。
lessons.description_en: Case workshop. Use payroll, contract and cash-flow reviews to identify missing data, conflicts and calculation issues. Examine repeats and review costs.

learningMaterial.content:
Testing and Improving Automations

用工资、合同和收支核对练习识别缺项、冲突和计算问题，检查重复执行与人工复核成本。

Preparation

Prepare normal inputs and cases with missing data, inconsistent values, duplicates and changed rules. Define what counts as a correct result.

Client brief

Run the checks, document failures and improve the workflow. Measure time spent preparing and reviewing a result; create an exception handover and monitoring checklist.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
10Client problemFrame this decision: Accept corrections or return the workflow for revision.
20Evidence and constraintsRead the case records and question the department roles. Identify the fact that could change your plan.

lessons.description: 工作坊：向客户角色展示工作流、核对结果和 Proposal，解释预算、范围、技术依赖与风险，回应质询并争取试点决定。
lessons.description_en: Workshop: Pitch the workflow, validation and proposal to client roles; defend budget, scope, technical dependencies and risks to seek a pilot decision.

learningMaterial.content:
The Business Case for AI

向客户角色展示工作流、核对结果和 Proposal，解释预算、范围、技术依赖与风险，回应质询并争取试点决定。

Preparation

Prepare a short client presentation using your complete output, checks, scope and budget assumptions. Keep the evidence behind each claim openable.

Client brief

Present a business case to operations, finance and IT roles. Respond to a budget cut or reduced reviewer availability. Revise scope, turnaround and responsibilities, and request a specific decision.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
10Client problemFrame this decision: Approve, revise or stop a bounded pilot.
20Evidence and constraintsRead the case records and question the department roles. Identify the fact that could change your plan.
25Workflow choicesPresent a business case to operations, finance and IT roles. Respond to a budget cut or reduced reviewer availability. Revise scope, turnaround and responsibilities, and request a specific decision.
35Produce and checkWork on business-case.md: problem, options, evidence, cost and recommendation; budget.csv: setup, tools, review, maintenance and sensitivity; decision-log.md: owner, conditions and changes agreed. Compare the output with its sources.
20Present for a decisionExplain the output, alternatives, budget assumptions and unresolved risks. Request: Approve, revise or stop a bounded pilot.
10Correction and ownershipCheck Explains why the chosen approach fits the business constraint.; Includes review and maintenance effort in the proposal.; Requests a named decision and records any unresolved objection. Record the correction and responsible owner.

Submission

  • business-case.md: problem, options, evidence, cost and recommendation
  • budget.csv: setup, tools, review, maintenance and sensitivity
  • decision-log.md: owner, conditions and changes agreed

Review criteria

  • Explains why the chosen approach fits the business constraint.
  • Includes review and maintenance effort in the proposal.
  • Requests a named decision and records any unresolved objection.

Decision to obtain

Approve, revise or stop a bounded pilot.

Knowledge check

A budget forecasts twenty hours of saved effort each month. Which statement is supported?

  • Twenty hours of capacity is estimated under the stated assumptions.
  • Twenty hours is guaranteed.
  • The company has already received a cash saving.
Answer and reasoning

Twenty hours of capacity is estimated under the stated assumptions.

A forecast is not an observed result or cash saving.

Reference reasoning

For the invoice case, estimate 20 hours of monthly capacity at 80% coverage and five minutes saved per accepted invoice. State assumptions. Reduced reviewer availability changes turnaround and queue design, not the need for approval.

lessons.name: AI Adoption and Business Value
lessons.title: AI Adoption and Business Value
lessons.description: 工作坊：完成项目展示与交接，用材料说明个人承担的调查、方案、验证和协作工作；对照目标 FDE 岗位识别需要继续补齐的能力。
lessons.description_en: Workshop: Present and hand over the project, explain your own discovery, design, validation and collaboration, and identify gaps against your target FDE role.

learningMaterial.content:
AI Adoption and Business Value

完成项目展示与交接，用材料说明个人承担的调查、方案、验证和协作工作；对照目标 FDE 岗位识别需要继续补齐的能力。

Preparation

Give a colleague the workflow, SOP, exception rules and review checklist. Note where they need additional explanation.

Client brief

Complete the final presentation and a peer handover. Compare the pilot plan with the original baseline, decide what remains uncertain and recommend continue, change or stop.

Run of session

MinutesActivityInstructions
10Client problemFrame this decision: Accept the handover or request specific corrections.
20Evidence and constraintsRead the case records and question the department roles. Identify the fact that could change your plan.
25Workflow choicesComplete the final presentation and a peer handover. Compare the pilot plan with the original baseline, decide what remains uncertain and recommend continue, change or stop.
35Produce and checkWork on pilot-plan.md: users, baseline, measures and expansion decision; handover.md: setup, owners, review queue and recovery; individual-contribution.md: work performed, decisions and evidence. Compare the output with its sources.
20Present for a decisionExplain the output, alternatives, budget assumptions and unresolved risks. Request: Accept the handover or request specific corrections.
10Correction and ownershipCheck A colleague can operate the workflow and handle a supplied exception.; Open issues have owners and next steps.; Each participant can explain their contribution and the effect of a changed condition. Record the correction and responsible owner.

Submission

  • pilot-plan.md: users, baseline, measures and expansion decision
  • handover.md: setup, owners, review queue and recovery
  • individual-contribution.md: work performed, decisions and evidence
  • role-to-evidence.md: target FDE responsibilities, your individual contribution, supporting project artefacts and remaining technical gaps

Review criteria

  • A colleague can operate the workflow and handle a supplied exception.
  • Open issues have owners and next steps.
  • Each participant can explain their contribution and the effect of a changed condition.
  • Explains individual decisions with project evidence and identifies remaining technical gaps against target FDE responsibilities.

Decision to obtain

Accept the handover or request specific corrections.

Knowledge check

A colleague cannot handle an exception without the author. What should happen before handover acceptance?

  • Accept because the author can do it.
  • Remove the exception.
  • Improve the instructions and have the receiver repeat the check.
Answer and reasoning

Improve the instructions and have the receiver repeat the check.

Handover tests whether another person can operate the workflow with the materials.

Reference reasoning

Handover is accepted when the receiver can trace an invoice field, explain a duplicate decision, revalidate a changed customer draft and identify the HR/IT owner of an onboarding blocker. An attractive presentation alone is insufficient.
